name: Transwind Infrastructures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Transwind Infrastructures Ltd is in the business of construction and related activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TWIL, based in Ahmedabad, is an infrastructure development and engineering company that executes turnkey projects across key sectors such as Indian Railways signaling and telecommunication, city gas distribution, water distribution networks, and irrigation. Its services include laying and commissioning MDPE gas pipelines, installing and maintaining optical fiber and quad cables, and executing civil and irrigation works.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.73 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 103 to 53.0 days.
Promoter holding has increased by 4.96% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 118 days to 52.3 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.68% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.69 Cr.
